messages:
marta: Quick q — for the private-beta design partner cohort we're tight on GPU slots. Do we tighten acceptance criteria or stagger start dates? Also legal pinged about NDAs vs MSA for partners, any strong ops preferences? :thinking:

kevin: I'm leaning toward staggered starts (rolling onboarding) to smooth capacity. Recommend 2-week waves. For contracts, prefer NDA for early partners, MSA once we go to paid pilots. @legal FYI. :thumbsup:

sara: +1 on rolling waves. Also propose an intake scoring rubric so we can prioritize high-impact use cases. Minimal ask: representative dataset, clear success metric, and a contact who can test weekly. I'll draft.

mo: To add some launch criteria that matter to engineering: we should require 3 integrations (at least 2 unique infra patterns), median inference latency <200ms on a 1k-sample synthetic workload, and no P0 stability regressions for 7 days. If any of these fail, we push a partner to a later wave.

kevin: Those are good hard gates. Also propose reserving ~30% capacity as buffer for spikes/experiments. Means we accept fewer partners per wave but better experience.

marta: OK — tradeoffs noted (velocity vs quality). Action items: Sara to draft rubric + intake form, Mo to define the test harness + perf checks, Kevin to propose capacity per wave numbers, and I'll coordinate legal (NDA/MSA) and communications.

ops-bot: Intake form template: https://go.example.com/dp-intake (internal). Use tags: use_case, expected_qps, data_sensitivity.

sara: Draft ready by EOD tomorrow. Will include scoring: impact (0-5), infra complexity (0-3), security risk (0-4), readiness (0-4).

mo: I'll put a reproducible perf test in a branch: `tests/dp_perf/README.md` with steps to run on dedicated pool. Will also add KV-cache warmup script.

kevin: For capacity numbers, thinking per-2-week wave: 6 partners active, reserve 3 slots for buffer, scale up as we automate onboarding. I'll post the spreadsheet update by EOD.

marta: Great. One more ask from @devex — can onboarding include a short runbook + 30min onboarding call? Helps retention.

sara: Yup will add onboarding checklist to intake (call scheduling link + runbook checkbox).

marta: Cool. We'll reconvene next Tues to review rubric and final wave sizing. Thanks all. :rocket:
